messages:
maria (support): URGENT customer Finovar: objects with custom retention=90d still searchable after ~120d. They need deletion timeline + proof for compliance audit today EOD. Sample object id: 8890a3, tenant: 6742-finovar. They can GET metadata and search returns the object. Can we triage? :rotating_light:

raj (infra-oncall): on it. Can you paste the curl you used and one full object id? Also, any recent KMS key rotation for that tenant?

maria (support): curl: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/6742/objects/8890a3/metadata\"` returns `{"id":"8890a3","retention":"90d","created":"2024-06-01T12:00:00Z"}`. Search: `POST /v1/tenants/6742/search {"q":"8890a3"}` returns hit with url `s3://.../8890a3`. Customer says object should have been deleted ~2024-08-30. No reported changes on their side.

raj (infra-oncall): I pulled deletion-queue logs for tenant 6742. Deletion enqueue for 8890a3 at `2024-08-30T03:05:12Z`. Deletion processor log shows processed tombstone at `2024-08-30T03:12:04Z` but indexer reported an error: `indexer: failed to apply tombstone id=8890a3 err=kms:DecryptDenied key=projects/prod/kms/kv-6742`.

nina (sre): Confirming. Index shard `search-6742-r2` had replication lag and the tombstone apply failed because indexer couldn't decrypt metadata while key rotation was in progress. Snippet from indexer: ```2024-08-30T03:11:59Z ERROR applyTombstone id=8890a3 kms_error=AccessDenied operation=Decrypt key=kv-6742 retry=0```

alex (security): Do we have audit-log entries for the KMS rotation and the indexer failures? Legal will need a complete trail.

raj (infra-oncall): Audit shows KMS key rotation for kv-6742 started `2024-08-30T02:58:20Z` and completed `2024-08-30T03:10:01Z`. Indexer attempted decrypts during that window and failed once, then retried later and succeeded at `2024-08-30T04:02:17Z`.

legal: We need an exported timeline and signed attestation that objects were enqueued and tombstoned, plus the reason they were briefly still searchable. Also put a legal hold on Finovar tenant logs until this is delivered.

maria (support): Noted. I told customer we will share export and timeline within 2 hours and set hold.

nina (sre): Immediate mitigation: forced reindex of affected doc ids and manual tombstone apply. Command run: `./ops/reindex --tenant 6742 --ids 8890a3 --force --quiet`. Reindex started `2024-08-30T03:45Z`.

raj (infra-oncall): Reindex completed `2024-08-30T03:52Z`. Verified search no longer returns 8890a3 from `eu-west-1` and `us-east-1` replicas. Tombstone present in index state.

raj (infra-oncall): Audit export summary: `enqueue=2024-08-30T03:05:12Z, tombstone-apply-failed=2024-08-30T03:12:04Z (kms:DecryptDenied), kms-rotation-start=2024-08-30T02:58:20Z, kms-rotation-end=2024-08-30T03:10:01Z, tombstone-apply-succeeded=2024-08-30T04:02:17Z, manual-reindex-forced=2024-08-30T03:45:00Z, reindex-complete=2024-08-30T03:52:00Z`. Full audit logs attached to support ticket.

alex (security): Root cause: transient KMS access denied during key rotation blocked indexer from decrypting object metadata, preventing tombstone indexing; index replication lag allowed stale shards to keep serving the hit until reindex. Action items: (1) Add retry/backoff and alert when indexer KMS decrypt fails; (2) improve tombstone propagation visibility; (3) add a guard that serves deletion based on storage tombstone if index reports hit.

nina (sre): Filing ENG-1234 (indexer: hard-fail on KMS decrypt during rotation) and SRE-789 (replication lag monitoring improvement). Will attach logs and repro steps.

maria (support): Customer update sent: "We've applied a manual reindex and confirm objects are no longer searchable. We're preparing export+attestation for legal. We'll follow up within 2 hours."

legal: Please include KMS rotation records in the attestation and confirm we held all related logs. Also capture which keys were active during the window.

maria (support): Will include. Finovar rep (via email): "Confirmed after your fix the search no longer returns the records. Requesting the attestation PDF and audit export."

raj (infra-oncall): Postmortem notes to include: timeline above, mitigations applied, customer communication, and permanent fixes. ETA for postmortem draft: 48 hours.

nina (sre): Follow-up: we'll scope a code change to ensure tombstones are prioritized over search hits when storage shows a tombstone present. Assigning to eng-runtime.

maria (support): Closing loop with customer now. If legal needs anything extra, ping me. :white_check_mark:
